name: review-pack
title: Internal review pack
for_each: select id,name from matters order by name

sections.title: Internal review pack
sections.note: Private working paper. Includes privilege information.
sections.sql: select source_id,name,owner,review_status,disposition,reason from review_register where matter_id=$1 order by source_id

name: privilege-log
title: Internal privilege log
for_each: select id,name from matters order by name

sections.title: Internal privilege log
sections.note: Lawyer must review privilege grounds and descriptions before any external use.
sections.sql: select source_id,name,reason,reviewer,review_status from review_register where matter_id=$1 and disposition='privileged' order by source_id

name: discovery-schedule
title: Draft discovery schedule
for_each: select id,name from matters order by name

sections.title: Draft discovery schedule
sections.note: Candidate schedule only. Excludes held records. Not a sworn affidavit or a production package; no source files are attached.
sections.sql: select source_id,name,custodian,document_date,adverse from disclosure_register where matter_id=$1 and readiness='candidate for lawyer review' order by source_id
